card.name: Linking words before dopamine agonist drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (as, with, versus, of, comma) right before a dopamine-agonist drug such as bromocriptine, in prolactin or pituitary tumor text.

modes.label: Linking word before the drug
modes.description: A word like 'as', 'with', 'versus' or 'of' that leads into a dopamine agonist or antagonist.
modes.example: Small tumors may be treated with a medication, such<< as>> a dopamine agonist.

modes.label: Comma in drug lists
modes.description: A comma after a dopamine-related drug name, before the next drug or class.

card.writes: It suppresses beta and β tokens, so it steers the next word away from beta-blocker or beta-named terms.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a dopamine drug like bromocriptine is named, and steers away from 'beta' terms.
